purpose: Frozen qualification workload; not Engine defaults or an existing support claim
measurementRules: Both execution tiers apply the target frame rate through the ordinary App frame pacer and measure actual ready completions
CPU substrate timings do not qualify Render, Physics, cold copying or real frames
Include acceptance and subsequent frame reconciliation, first native step and shadow work
No idle-frame dilution, skipped assertions or post-result budget relaxation
Measure all lifecycle windows; retain longest pauses and events above 33 and 50 ms
Freeze browser and adapter identity before each comparison; uncontrolled contention is reported
The preparation slice sets when to yield before the next item. Record actual item, acceptance, first update and slice costs as timing diagnostics
Missing runtime or backend evidence remains unverified

memoryMeasurement.perCohortWarmBaseline: First fully retired target cycle at the same inactive-copy count; retained inactive Sources remain prepared
memoryMeasurement.logicalOwnedBytes: World arena committed + managed/owned pool committed and metadata + unique table/entity/archetype backing + Asset runtime bytes/snapshotBytes/adoptionBytes + live RHI buffer descriptor bytes and texture mip/block/sample logical bytes + retained GPU Scene CPU table bytes
memoryMeasurement.heapBytes: Independent post-collection populations: Node heapUsed, external, arrayBuffers; Chromium precise JS heap and measureUserAgentSpecificMemory agent bytes including external backing/WASM. Unavailable observation is unverified.
memoryMeasurement.gate: Each population independently <= its same-cohort warm baseline * 1.05 + 1048576; no offsetting growth between populations
memoryMeasurement.limits: Logical requested bytes are not physical driver VRAM. Overlapping host populations are gated independently rather than summed. Native Rapier body counts and Source custody counts are checked separately.
memoryMeasurement.sampling: After actual Source retirement and receipt completion, pause ordinary App scheduling for explicit host collection and cold memory inspection; retain that measurement pause separately and resume with an explicit interval boundary
